verdict.rationale: Supermemory documents official TypeScript (npm install supermemory) and Python (pip install supermemory) clients that wrap its API, so the core need for official SDKs in both languages is met. However, every code sample in the pack (client.add, client.search) is TypeScript only, and nothing shows the Python client exposes the same memory operations. Missing for 10: documented API parity or equivalent memory methods across the Python and TypeScript SDKs, Python usage examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of either SDK.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against official SDKs in at least Python and TypeScript with equivalent memory APIs

citations.quote: Official clients wrap this API: TypeScript: npm install supermemory Python: pip install supermemory
await client.add({ content: "The user loves Paris.", containerTag: "user_123" });
const results = await client.search({ q: "where does Alex work?", containerTag: "user_123", include: { relatedMemories: true }, });
